1. (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than __600__ Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

2. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker __selected from aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate__.

3. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is polyethylenimine.

4. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from [[sodium polyvinyl sulfonate,]] poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants.

5. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed [[zirconium]] __aluminum__ compound selected from the group consisting of [[zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate,]] aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, [[aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate]] __and aluminum citrate__.

6. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions.

7. (Original) The composition of claim 4, wherein said anionic surfactant is selected from the group consisting of sodium dodecyl sulfate, sodium lauryl sulfate, alcohol propoxy sulfate, olefin sulfonates, and alpha olefin sulfonates.

8. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex comprised a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about __200__ to 900 nm in diameter.

9. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticles are stable in water, field brine and seawater.

10. (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine __of less than 600 Da__ and [[polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS)]] __poly (sodium acrylate)__, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

11. (Original) The composition of claim 10, said polyalkylenimine being less than 2000 Da.

12. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation __selected from Al, Ti, Fe and Sn__.

13. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising [[Zr, Cr,]] Ti, Fe or Al.

14. (Original) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle for delivery of an oil and gas chemical to a reservoir, said composition comprising a polyethylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion intimately associated with an oil and gas field chemical to form a polyelectrolyte complex, said complex having an average particle size of less than one micron.

15. (Original) A composition for controlled release of an oil and gas field chemical comprising: a) a polyanion and a polyethylenimine of less than 2000 Da forming a polyelectrolyte complex; b) said polyelectrolyte complex intimately associated with an oil and gas chemical selected from the group consisting of a (a) a gel-forming or cross-linking agent, (b) a scale inhibitor, (c) a corrosion inhibitor, (d) an inhibitor of asphaltene or wax 3 COP: 42166USdeposition, (e) a hydrogen sulfide scavenger, (f) a hydrate inhibitor, (g) a breaking agent, and (h) a surfactant; and c) said polyelectrolyte complex having an average particle size less than 1000 nm.

16. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 15, said polyanion comprising [[PVS]] __poly (sodium acrylate)__.

17. (Original) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyethylenimine (PEI) of less than 2000 Da and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS) intimately associated with a zirconium ion crosslinker, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, wherein said nanoparticle has a predominance of negative charges and the amount of PVS exceeds the amount of PEI.

18. (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyethylenimine (PEI) of less than __600__ Da and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS) intimately associated with a zirconium ion crosslinker, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, wherein said nanoparticle has a predominance of positive charges and the amount of PEI exceeds the amount of PVS __by at least 20% by weight__.

19. (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyethylenimine (PEI) of less than __600__ Da and a polyanion intimately associated with a metal ion crosslinker, wherein said polyanion is selected from [[sodium polyvinyl sulfonate,]] poly (sodium acrylate) poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate, dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants, and where the metal ion crosslinker is selected from aluminum, iron, titanium, [[chromium, zirconium]] __tin__ and complexes of same.

20. (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a delayed gelling agent comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyethylenimine of less than __600__ Da and a polyvinyl sulfonate intimately associated with a multivalent metal cation crosslinker __selected from aluminum, iron, titanium, and tin__, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron; b) a polymer having anionic sites that can be crosslinked with said metal cation crosslinker; and c) a fluid.

21. (Previously presented) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer that can be crosslinked with a); and c) a fluid.

22. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is an acrylate-based polymer.

23. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is partially hydrolyzed polyacrylamide __having a molecular weight of at least 5 million Da__.

24. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethyacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, or N,N-dimethylacrylamide.

25. (Original) The composition of claim 20, where said metal crosslinker is zirconium or aluminum.

26. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 21, where fluid is brine or seawater.

27. (Original) An improved method of sweeping a reservoir, wherein an injection fluid is injected into a reservoir to mobilize and produce oil, the improvement comprising injecting the composition claim 1 plus a polymer plus a fluid into a reservoir, aging said composition and polymer to increase its viscosity, injecting additional injection fluid into said reservoir to mobilize oil, and producing said oil.

28. (Original) A method of improving sweep efficiency of a fluid flood of a reservoir, said method comprising: a) injecting the composition of claim 20 into a reservoir; b) aging the composition to increase its viscosity; c) injecting an injection fluid into said reservoir to mobilize the oil; and d) producing said mobilized oil.
